notes.note: Title of the languages page and its entry in the browser tab.
Subtitle of the languages page.

segment.source: The languages of the user interface: built in, uploaded and active
segment.target: Användargränssnittets språk: inbyggda, uppladdade och aktiva

notes.note: Introduction above the upload form of the languages page.

segment.source: English and Swedish are built in. Upload an XLIFF 2.0 language pack to add a language or to change the texts of a built-in one. The server checks the pack; you preview it in this tab, then activate it for everyone.
segment.target: Engelska och svenska är inbyggda. Ladda upp ett språkpaket i XLIFF 2.0 för att lägga till ett språk eller ändra texterna i ett inbyggt. Servern kontrollerar paketet; du förhandsgranskar det i den här fliken och aktiverar det sedan för alla.

notes.note: Button that downloads the English template, the key set of the user interface as an XLIFF file for translators.
Short button in a language row that downloads the template of that language.
Accessible name of the template button of a language row. The argument name is the language's own name.
Button that shows the uploaded version of a language in this browser tab before it is activated.
Button that makes the uploaded version of a language available to everyone.
Button that deletes the uploaded version of a language that is not active.
Button that shows the validation report of a language pack.
Button that removes a language that is not built in.
Button that returns a built-in language to its built-in texts.
Tooltip of the disabled activate button while the uploaded version has not been previewed.

Help text under the file field of the upload form.

segment.target: Ett XLIFF 2.0-dokument på högst 2 MiB där trgLang anger språket. Utgå från mallen.

notes.note: Button that uploads the chosen language pack.

Shown in a version column when there is no such version.
Completeness of a pack. The argument percent is a whole number from 0 to 100.
The pack's own version, as its author wrote it.

Note on an uploaded version that was previewed.
Note on an uploaded version that nobody has previewed yet.

segment.source: Everyone can choose {name}, and every open window that shows it switches to this version.
segment.target: Alla kan välja {name}, och alla öppna fönster som visar språket byter till den här versionen.

notes.note: Confirm button of an activation.
Title of the confirmation before an uploaded version is discarded.
Consequence of discarding an uploaded version.

segment.source: The uploaded version is deleted. An active version stays as it is.
segment.target: Den uppladdade versionen raderas. En aktiv version ligger kvar som den är.

notes.note: Confirm button of a discard.
Title of the confirmation before a language that is not built in is removed.
Consequence of removing a language.

segment.source: Every uploaded version of {name} is deleted. Users who chose it see their browser language or the default language instead.
segment.target: Alla uppladdade versioner av {name} raderas. Användare som valt språket ser i stället webbläsarens språk eller standardspråket.

notes.note: Confirm button of a removal.
Title of the confirmation before a built-in language returns to its built-in texts.
Consequence of reverting a built-in language.

segment.source: The uploaded texts of {name} are deleted, and everyone sees the built-in texts again.
segment.target: De uppladdade texterna för {name} raderas, och alla ser de inbyggda texterna igen.

Button in the preview bar that ends the preview.

notes.note: Error: the pack is over the size limit.

segment.source: The pack is larger than 2 MiB.

notes.note: Error: there is no pack for the language.

segment.source: There is no language pack for this language.
segment.target: Det finns inget språkpaket för det här språket.

notes.note: Error: the language has no uploaded version waiting.

segment.source: This language has no uploaded version waiting.
segment.target: Det här språket har ingen uppladdad version som väntar.

notes.note: Error: an activation before a preview.

segment.source: Preview the uploaded version before you activate it.
segment.target: Förhandsgranska den uppladdade versionen innan du aktiverar den.

notes.note: Error: the language is the default language of the installation.

segment.source: This language is the default language of the installation. Choose another default language first.
segment.target: Det här språket är installationens standardspråk. Välj ett annat standardspråk först.

notes.note: Error: the upload has no file.

segment.target: Välj en fil att ladda upp.

notes.note: Error: the upload is not one file in a multipart form.

segment.source: Upload one XLIFF file at a time.
segment.target: Ladda upp en XLIFF-fil i taget.

notes.note: Error: the server has no built-in user interface to check packs against.

segment.source: This server has no built-in user interface to check language packs against.
segment.target: Den här servern har inget inbyggt användargränssnitt att kontrollera språkpaket mot.

notes.note: Problem: the file is not well-formed XML or has a DOCTYPE.

segment.source: The file is not well-formed XML, or it has a DOCTYPE.
segment.target: Filen är inte välformad XML, eller så har den en DOCTYPE.

notes.note: Problem: the document is not XLIFF 2.0.
Problem: an XLIFF version other than 2.0.
Problem: a structure language packs do not use (one file, one segment per unit).

segment.source: This structure is not supported: one file, one segment per unit.
segment.target: Strukturen stöds inte: en fil, ett segment per enhet.

notes.note: Problem: the document has too many units.

segment.source: The document has too many units.

notes.note: Problem: the pack does not translate from English.

segment.source: The pack must translate from English (srcLang en).
segment.target: Paketet måste översätta från engelska (srcLang en).

notes.note: Problem: trgLang is missing.

segment.source: trgLang is missing: it names the language of the pack.
segment.target: trgLang saknas: det anger paketets språk.

notes.note: Problem: trgLang is not a valid language tag in canonical form.

segment.source: trgLang is not a valid language tag, such as fr or pt-BR.
segment.target: trgLang är ingen giltig språktagg, som fr eller pt-BR.

notes.note: Problem: the language pack metadata (display name, author, version) is missing or invalid.

segment.source: The language pack metadata is missing or invalid.
segment.target: Språkpaketets metadata saknas eller är ogiltig.

notes.note: Problem: the pack translates nothing the user interface uses.

segment.source: The pack translates no message of this user interface.
segment.target: Paketet översätter inget meddelande i det här användargränssnittet.

notes.note: Problem: a translation contains XLIFF inline markup.

segment.source: Inline markup is not allowed in a translation.
segment.target: Inline-markering är inte tillåten i en översättning.

notes.note: Problem: a key appears twice; the first one is used.

segment.source: The key appears more than once; the first one is used.
segment.target: Nyckeln förekommer mer än en gång; den första används.

notes.note: Problem: a unit id is not a message key.

segment.source: The unit id is not a message key.

notes.note: Problem: a translation is not a valid ICU message.

segment.source: The translation is not a valid ICU message.

notes.note: Problem: a translation uses an argument the English text does not have.

segment.target: Översättningen använder ett argument som den engelska texten inte har.

notes.note: Problem: a translation contains a control character.

segment.source: The translation contains a control character.
